_readme: Codex hook config (merge into ~/.codex/hooks.json, or the repo-level file). Same sortie-lock list (plug.yaml: outbound), same script gates/outbound.py.

A PreToolUse hook blocks by printing the deny JSON (hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision: deny, non-empty reason) and exiting 0 — on both pilots (D65). Hooks are fail-open; each Codex hook has to be trusted once by hand, and again after every change (D58). Prefer `plug init`: it writes the bare, space-separated command form Codex needs (D53).
The Stop hook is the record reminder: it never blocks and always exits 0.
Replace //c/<entryplug-repo> with wherever you cloned entryplug, and //c/<content-repo> with the content repo.
